text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She had given it everything she had. In 
this race, had she managed to show Sensei 
hope? Nakayama Festa's heart swelled with 
anticipation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What awaited her, however, was cruel 
reality. In the hospital room, her 
mentor's body was gaunt, his voice 
raspy—she thought to herself, "Did my 
actions even mean anything at all?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa was beginning to lose hope 
in her own actions. Just then, Tosen 
Jordan appeared before her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She said watching Nakayama Festa run made 
her want to "live." She told me to face 
her in the Chunichi Shimbun Hai!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her own actions had changed destiny. 
Spurred on by that glimmer of hope, 
Nakayama Festa fired herself up—ready for 
the upcoming Chunichi Shimbun Hai!
